Patagonia’s Black Hole might have set the standard for duffel bags, but it is far from the only worthy option. Any bag brand (or brand that makes bags) worth its salt should have an option that is at least somewhat comparable, and some could be argued as better.

Welcome to Shop Smarter: A series dedicated to highlighting not just what’s on sale, but why it’s worth owning. Discover more here.

One of the chief competitors to the Black Hole is The North Face’s Base Camp Voyager Duffel, and right now the 42-liter option is deeply discounted at REI.

Heavy hauler

At 42 liters, this bag is big enough for longer trips, should you know how to pack smartly (I suggest looking into packing cubes). However, it’s also still sized to meet most overhead carry-on restrictions.

It’s also incredibly durable and lightweight, courtesy of its TPU-laminated 300d tarpaulin exterior with a DWR 840d ballistic nylon base. And it has a wealth of organizational options, much more than typical duffels, including a separate ventilated shoe compartment.

And if the internal organization isn’t enough, there are lash point around the exterior for additional modular attachments. The one downside: it’s only the Soapstone colorway at this price.

However, if you want something a little smaller and way more affordable, REI has another option in its own REI Big Haul 28 Duffel, which is 50 percent off right now.

Availability and pricing

The North Face’s Base Camp Voyager Duffel 42L is now available on REI for $105 (down from $150), while the REI Big Haul 28 Duffel is just $50 (down from $100).
